    Homogeneous splitting of a finite identity decomposition #

    Taking degree zero in ∑ gⱼ fⱼ = 1 gives a finite sum of endomorphisms of the graded source. In a local endomorphism ring, one summand is a unit. The corresponding homogeneous map splits into one shifted target. If that target also has local endomorphisms, the split map is an isomorphism.

        One homogeneous component splits when the graded source endomorphism ring is local. Neither a covering hypothesis nor an orbit-density theorem is needed for this conclusion.
